speaker: Sheldon
text: You just lied to Penny. But you did it so casually. No rapid breathing, no increase in perspiration. So lack of a physiological response while lying is characteristic of a violent sociopath.

speaker: Leonard
text: Sheldon, are you worried about your safety?

speaker: Sheldon
text: No. I imagine if you were going to kill me, you'd have done it a long time ago.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Leonard? Leonard? Leonard? I need to speak to you.

speaker: Leonard
text: It's two o'clock in the morning. I highly doubt that. No way. Is it still you still out there?

speaker: Sheldon
text: What? You're right, it's way too early.
